title: Develop merge CI fails on duplicate Gherkin steps and pytest write path
description:
As a Kanbus maintainer, I want CI green on develop after the right-now merge, so semantic-release can cut a version from main.

## Symptom

CI on `74c28509` failed python, rust, and python-console-parity:
https://github.com/AnthusAI/Kanbus/actions/runs/33674596293

## Causes

- `@given("mock AI is enabled")` is defined in both lifecycle and right-now steps (Python and Rust).
- `@given('the Kanbus configuration uses AI provider ...')` is defined in both compaction and right-now steps.
- `test_update_issue_matching_values_succeed_without_write` patches `write_issue_to_file`, which issue_update no longer exposes.
- Rust cucumber does not skip feature-level `@slow` or `@cloud`, so embedded-assets and GitHub webhook specs fail in the default rust job.
- `.kanbus.yml` has a duplicate `ai:` block from the merge.

## Definition of Done

- One definition of each shared Gherkin step; lifecycle/compaction keep the canonical copy; mock AI also clears `KANBUS_RIGHT_NOW_LITELLM_CALLED`.
- Matching-values update test asserts persist was not called.
- Default rust cucumber skips `@slow` (feature and scenario) and `@cloud`.
- Duplicate `ai:` key removed from `.kanbus.yml`.
- pytest, behave (CI tags), and targeted rust cucumber pass.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Local verification: pytest, behave (CI tags: 1002 passed), rust cucumber (928 passed, 6 skipped), cargo fmt, and clippy all green. Duplicate Gherkin steps removed. PR: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Kanbus/pull/207

right_now_summary: Local checks pass, duplicate steps are removed, and PR #207 is ready for review.
